claim_definition: Verifies that an agent's deployment trust score decays exponentially over time according to the AGT governance model and that a score which falls below the re-attestation threshold triggers a mandatory re-attestation gate. A trust score that was valid at deployment provides no assurance after sufficient time has elapsed without re-attestation.
scope: AGT trust score decay engine; deployment trust lifecycle; mandatory re-attestation gate
excluded_scope: Manual trust score overrides; hardware-reset events that reinitialise the score counter

test_cases.description: After 90 days (7,776,000 seconds) with decay_rate=1.5e-7, an initial score of 0.95 decays to ~0.296, below the 0.50 threshold — mandatory re-attestation gate triggers.
After 7 days (604,800 seconds) with the same parameters, score decays to ~0.868 — still above threshold. Gate remains open, no re-attestation required.
